IBM AT optional 80287 socket profile; select exact board, speed grade, clock and BIOS. Legacy 287 and later 287XL behavior need separate qualification. Optional configuration, not a factory-installed claim or base-machine POST prerequisite.

Preserved IBM Model 70 specification lists an optional 80387. Select the DX PGA part and clock for the exact 8570 planar; not an SX socket. Optional configuration, not a factory-installed claim or base-machine POST prerequisite.
Model 35 SX planar U29 is the i387SX socket; select the 20 MHz host-compatible grade and exact board/ROM. Optional configuration, not a factory-installed claim or base-machine POST prerequisite.

IBM announcement 192-019 specifies a math-coprocessor socket and 16 MHz 386SX. Planned 387SX candidate inferred from that host interface; confirm the exact K00 planar/socket and clock before acceptance. Optional configuration, not a factory-installed claim or base-machine POST prerequisite.

Selected 8556 386SLC planar U41 accepts a 68-pin PLCC 387SX socket or a CPU upgrade module. Qualify the installed adapter, 20 MHz grade and exact board; the CPU upgrade is a distinct option. Optional configuration, not a factory-installed claim or base-machine POST prerequisite.

Planned LAPC-I ISA audio option. Roland’s manual requires a full-length 13-inch slot; qualify the exact chassis/riser clearance, power, PCB/ROM revision, IRQ 2/9 routing, I/O settings and original software. Not a factory-installed part or base-machine POST prerequisite; not an MCA card.
